Title: De Sades special and Kindred Manipulation

Messages.Author: Hobbesgoblin
Messages.Body:
De Sade cally a referendum
Vampire A votes against and burns one blood
De Sade plays Kindred Manipulation to change A's vote in favor.
Does the Blood stay burned?

De Sade cally a referendum
Vampire A votes in favor.
De Sade plays Kindred Manipulation to change A's vote to against
Does A burn blood now?

(I think yes for both cases, but I just wanted to ask for confirmation)

De Sade

Kindred Manipulation

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Hobbesgoblin wrote:
> De Sade cally a referendum
> Vampire A votes against and burns one blood
> De Sade plays Kindred Manipulation to change A's vote in favor.
> Does the Blood stay burned?
>
Yes.

> Hobbesgoblin wrote:
> De Sade cally a referendum
> Vampire A votes in favor.
> De Sade plays Kindred Manipulation to change A's vote to against
> Does A burn blood now?
>
No. A has already cast their votes. KC changes the way they vote but does not force the vampire to cast votes, and the blood is burned in order to cast votes specifically.

A card that would "force" A to vote would cause A to burn 1 blood if A hasn't already cast their votes.

Prince of Paris, France
